dialogues.speaker: Moriguchi
dialogues.text: My wife is on Watatsumi Island. I have to serve here because of the war, so we've been separated.

dialogues.speaker: Moriguchi
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree has not only hurt people with Visions, but also the commoners like us. This law... It could burn in a fire, for all I care.

dialogues.speaker: Moriguchi
dialogues.text: But it's all over now! Isn't that wonderful?

dialogues.speaker: Moriguchi
dialogues.text: Once I return home to my wife, I'll tell her this good news for sure...
